row-actions.script: def z = zinr ?: com.zenith.Fmt.INSTANCE def money = { v -> '₹' + z.inr(ec.l10n.format((v ?: 0) as BigDecimal, '#,##0.00')) } beforeDisp = money(eb.firstBefore) afterDisp = money(eb.lastAfter) def diff = (eb.lastAfter ?: 0.0G) - (eb.firstBefore ?: 0.0G) diffDisp = (diff > 0.0G ? '+' : (diff < 0.0G ? '-' : '')) + money(diff.abs()).replace('₹','₹') diffStyle = (diff > 0.0G ? 'z-txt-red text-weight-medium' : (diff < 0.0G ? 'z-amt-green text-weight-medium' : 'text-grey-7')) dateDisp = eb.lastDate ? ec.l10n.format(eb.lastDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a') : '—'
